verdict.rationale: Hatchet officially ships Python, TypeScript, Go and Ruby SDKs (hatchet-gh-2, hatchet-docs-24) and community members confirm using it across multiple languages (hatchet-comm-15), supporting the core 'author in your language' claim. However, several documented features (CEL expression debugging, cron creation via Python reference) are only shown in Python-specific docs, and there is no explicit cross-SDK feature-parity matrix or changelog confirming equal capabilities across all four SDKs. Missing for 10: explicit feature-parity documentation/matrix across SDKs, confirmation that newer features (e.g., CEL debug tools, concurrency strategies) are available uniformly in Go/Ruby/TypeScript, and independent hands-on validation of parity beyond basic usability.
